title: Rework legacy token adapters and audit XML signer for SAML/JWT safety
creator: Priya Nair
description: Background: Several services still rely on legacy token adapters and a homegrown SAML XML signer/validator that were quick patches during early SSO onboarding. Recent dependency scans flagged multiple transitive CVEs (crypto and xml parsing) and our internal pen-test called out algorithm whitelist gaps for JWT validation. Goal: Replace fragile adapters with a consolidated, audited token parsing library and replace the XML signing/verification path with a hardened, maintained SAML library. Scope: auth-service (Go), gateway token middleware (Node), and SSO bridge (Python) — unify validation rules and centralize key handling so KMS/HSM integrations can be applied consistently. Deliverables: 1) Migrate JWT parsing to golang-jwt v4 with explicit alg whitelist and strict claim validation; 2) Introduce go-jose for JWE/JWS scenarios and centralize JWK fetching/caching; 3) Replace the bespoke XML signer with crewjam/saml (upgraded and patched) in the SSO bridge and remove brittle XPath-based validation; 4) Upgrade OpenSSL consumers to 3.2.x in the legacy image and ensure we do not regress on FIPS modes when enabled; 5) Comprehensive integration test matrix with Okta, Azure AD, and a mock IdP; 6) Canary rollout plan and automatic rollback on error rate or auth latency regressions. Success criteria: no high/critical CVEs in the dependency tree, CI integration tests passing across three IdP sims, and canary traffic (5%) running for 72 hours without auth failures or >10% latency increase.
acceptance_criteria: All token parsers reject 'alg:none' and unknown algs
JWK cache respects cache-control and fails open only when fallback allowed
SAML assertions validated with schema + signature check (no XPath-only checks)
Integration tests against Okta/Azure mock IdPs green in CI
Canary telemetry shows error rate <= baseline + 0.5%
implementation_notes: auth-service: replace jwt adapters in pkg/auth/token.go, add jose wrapper in pkg/auth/jose_client.go
gateway: add token-compat adapter to translate old auth headers for 2 releases
sso-bridge: port XML signer to crewjam/saml and add xmlsec bindings for RSA-PSS where supported
add e2e test harness in infra/tests/sso/ with recorded IdP responses
risks_and_mitigation: Broken third-party IdP layouts — maintain a compatibility shim for two releases
Key rotation cadence might expose race — use versioned JWK sets and accept-old-keys window (24h)
OpenSSL upgrade could change TLS cipher defaults — run full interop matrix prior to rollout
